accordion.description: Stacked sections that expand one at a time, or several at once.

alert.description: A message that stays on the page, with an optional icon.

alert-dialog.description: A modal that asks the user to confirm or cancel; clicking outside does not dismiss it.

aspect-ratio.description: A box that keeps a width-to-height ratio, filled by its content.

autocomplete.description: A text input with suggestions; the value is whatever the user types.

avatar.description: A person's picture, with initials while it loads or if it fails. Includes a status badge and overlapping groups.

badge.description: A short status or count label.

breadcrumb.description: Where the current page sits in the site's hierarchy.

button.description: An action trigger with default, outline, secondary, ghost, destructive, and link variants.

button-group.description: Joins related Buttons into one row that shares borders.

calendar.description: A month grid for picking a single date, a range, or several dates, built on react-day-picker.

card.description: A surface that groups related content.

carousel.description: A slideshow built on Embla, composed from Root, Content, Item, Previous, and Next.

checkbox.description: A checkbox with checked, unchecked, and indeterminate states.

checkbox-group.description: Shares one array value between a set of Checkboxes, with optional select-all.

collapsible.description: A section that shows and hides its panel.

combobox.description: Picks a value from a list you can filter by typing.

command.description: A searchable command list with groups, shortcuts, and an empty state, inline or in a dialog.

context-menu.description: A menu opened by right-clicking or long-pressing an area.

dashboard-overview.description: A dashboard home with headline stats, progress toward goals, and recent invoices.

dashboard-shell.description: An app shell with a collapsible sidebar, workspace switcher, user menu, breadcrumb, and search.

data-table.description: A table with sortable columns, row selection, and pagination, built on Table in plain React state.

date-picker.description: A button that opens a Calendar in a Popover to pick a date or a date range.

dialog.description: A modal window composed from Root, Trigger, Content, Header, Footer, Title, Description, and Close.

drawer.description: A modal panel that slides in from any edge of the screen and can be swiped away.

dropdown-menu.description: A menu of actions opened from a button, with checkbox, radio, and submenu items.

empty.description: An empty state with media, a title, a description, and actions.

field.description: Groups a control with its label, description, and error, and wires up accessibility and validation.

fieldset.description: Groups related fields under a legend; disabling it disables every field inside.

form.description: A form that validates its Fields together and focuses the first invalid one on submit.

foundations.description: Semantic StyleX variables for color, typography, spacing, radius, elevation, and motion, named media queries and layers, plus a dark theme and the typefaces.

hover-card.description: A preview of a link's destination, shown while a pointer rests on the link.

icons.description: The icons Shelf components use, in one file you own. lucide-react by default; swap the imports to change libraries.

input.description: A text input that takes part in a Field's label, description, and validation.

input-group.description: An input with text, icons, or buttons attached inside its border.

input-otp.description: A one-time code input with one slot per character and paste support.

invoices-table.description: An invoices list with search, a status filter, column visibility, row actions, and empty states.

item.description: A list row of media, a title, a description, and actions, that can render as a link.

label.description: A text label for a form control.

login-form.description: A sign-in card with email and password fields, validation, a pending state, and SSO.

login-split.description: A full-page sign-in with a brand panel and quote beside the login form.

menubar.description: A row of menus, as in a desktop app, with arrow-key movement between them.

meter.description: A measurement within a known range, such as storage used.

native-select.description: The browser's own select, styled to match Input and Select, with option groups.

navigation-menu.description: Site navigation where items open panels of links in one shared surface.

number-field.description: A number input with step buttons, keyboard stepping, and locale-aware formatting.

otp-verification.description: A card that asks for a six-digit code, with verify and resend actions.

pagination.description: Links between the pages of a long list.

popover.description: Rich, interactive content in a floating panel opened from a button.

progress.description: How far along a task is, or that it is in progress.

radio-group.description: A set of options where exactly one can be chosen, with arrow-key navigation.

resizable.description: Panels resized by dragging or the keyboard, composed from Group, Panel, and Handle.

scroll-area.description: A native scrolling region with thin, themed scrollbars.

select.description: Picks one value from a list of options.

separator.description: A horizontal or vertical dividing line.

settings-section.description: A profile settings section with text fields, a notification switch, and Save and Cancel.

sidebar.description: An app-shell sidebar that collapses offcanvas or to icons and becomes a sheet on small screens.

sidebar-nested.description: An app shell whose sidebar sections expand into sub-pages, with search in the header.

signup-form.description: A sign-up card with name, email, and password fields, a terms checkbox, and a pending state.

skeleton.description: A placeholder shape while content loads.

slider.description: A draggable input for a single value or a range.

switch.description: An on/off control that takes effect immediately.

table.description: A semantic HTML table with Shelf styles.

tabs.description: Switches between panels of related content.

textarea.description: A multi-line text input that grows with its content and takes part in a Field.

toast.description: Brief notifications queued from anywhere in the app.

toggle.description: A two-state button with default and outline variants.

toggle-group.description: A set of Toggles sharing one value, with arrow-key navigation.

toolbar.description: A row of controls that is one Tab stop, with arrow-key movement.

tooltip.description: A short label shown on hover and keyboard focus.

typography.description: Prose styles for headings, paragraphs, lead text, quotes, lists, and inline code.

usage-explorer.description: Charts of where registry items are installed, what state each copy is in, and how far behind it has drifted, from shelf usage output.

utils.description: Shared types and helpers used by Shelf components.
